meta.parties: Roche Et Al. v. Keerthiratne Et Al

rules.statement: The court has the discretion to add new parties under section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code, and this addition does not result in misjoinder of causes of action.
rules.supporting_quote: "No doubt the court has a discretionary power to allow or refuse the addition of new parties, but in this case the District Judge has exercised his jurisdiction in favour of the addition of the parties."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code
